questions.question: Moses and Aaron told Pharaoh of Egypt to let God's people go. Why did the LORD want them to go?

answers.text: To hold a feast to Him in the wilderness
To go back to their own land for good
To rest from their labor for a season

questions.question: When Pharaoh made the Israelites' work harder, what did he stop giving them for making bricks?
After Pharaoh made the Israelites' work harder, what did Moses ask the LORD?

answers.text: Why have You brought trouble upon this people
Who will You send to Pharaoh instead of me
How long must Your people wait in Egypt

questions.question: The LORD told Moses that because of His strong hand, what would Pharaoh do to the Israelites?

answers.text: Drive them out of his land
